title: Heading Tidy
noDoc: Open a document first, then run Heading Tidy.
summary: {t} headings. {s} look like sentences or body text (suggested for conversion), {k} skip a level.
help: Fixes OCR or PDF imports where whole paragraphs became headings. Review the ticks, then convert. Headings that contain one of the exception words are kept.
confirmPara: Convert {n} headings to plain paragraphs? Their text, formatting and block IDs stay the same.
confirmFix: Convert {p} headings to paragraphs and change the level of {n} other headings so no level is skipped?
blocked: {n} headings would go past h1 or h6. Nothing was changed.
undoNote: Changes can be rolled back from the document history (right click the document, History).
